entries.title: John 16:1
segments: I have spoken to you in this way so that you may not falter.

entries.title: John 16:2
segments: They will expel you from their Synagogues; indeed the time is coming when any one who kills you will think that he is making an offering to God.

entries.title: John 16:3
segments: They will do this, because they have not learned to know the Father, or even me.

entries.title: John 16:4
segments: But I have spoken to you of these things that, when the time for them comes, you may remember that I told you about them myself.

entries.title: John 16:5
segments: I did not tell you all this at first, because I was with you. But now I am to return to him who sent me; and yet not one of you asks me--'Where are you going?'

entries.title: John 16:6
segments: Although your hearts are full of sorrow at all that I have been saying to you.

entries.title: John 16:7
segments: Yet I am only telling you the truth; it is for your good that I should go away. For otherwise the Helper will never come to you, but, if I leave you, I will send him to you.

entries.title: John 16:8
segments: And he, when he comes, will bring conviction to the world as to Sin, and as to Righteousness, and as to Judgement;

entries.title: John 16:9
segments: As to Sin, for men do not believe in me;

entries.title: John 16:10
segments: As to Righteousness, for I am going to the Father, and you will see me no longer;

entries.title: John 16:11
segments: As to Judgment, for the Spirit that is ruling this world has been condemned.

entries.title: John 16:12
segments: I have still much to say to you, but you cannot bear it now.

entries.title: John 16:13
segments: Yet when he--The Spirit of Truth--comes, he will guide you into all Truth; for he will not speak on his own authority, but he will speak of all that he hears; and he will tell you of the things that are to come.

entries.title: John 16:14
segments: He will honor me; because he will take of what is mine, and will tell it to you.

entries.title: John 16:15
segments: Everything that the Father has is mine; that is why I said that he takes of what is mine, and will tell it to you.

entries.title: John 16:16
segments: In a little while you will no longer see me; and then in a little while you will see me indeed."

entries.title: John 16:17
segments: At this some of his disciples said to one another: "What does he mean by saying to us 'In a little while you will not see me, and then in a little while you will see me indeed'; and by saying 'Because I am going to the Father'?

entries.title: John 16:18
segments: What does he mean by 'In a little while'?" they said; "we do not know what he is speaking about."

entries.title: John 16:19
segments: Jesus saw that they were wanting to ask him a question, and said: "Are you trying to find out from one another what I meant by saying 'In a little while you will not see me; and then in a little while you will see me indeed'?

entries.title: John 16:20
segments: In truth I tell you that you will weep and mourn, but the world will rejoice; you will suffer pain, but your pain shall turn to joy.

entries.title: John 16:21
segments: A woman in labor is in pain because her time has come; but no sooner is the child born, than she forgets her trouble in her joy that a man has been born into the world.

entries.title: John 16:22
segments: You, in the same way, are sorry now; but I shall see you again, and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will rob you of your joy.

entries.title: John 16:23
segments: And at that time you will not ask me anything; in truth I tell you, if you ask the Father for anything, he will grant it to you in my Name.

entries.title: John 16:24
segments: So far you have not asked for anything, in my Name; ask, and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.

entries.title: John 16:25
segments: I have spoken to you of all this in figures; a time is coming, however, when I shall not speak any longer to you in figures, but shall tell you about the Father plainly.

entries.title: John 16:26
segments: You will ask, at that time, in my Name; and I do not say that I will intercede with the Father for you;

entries.title: John 16:27
segments: For the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from the Father.

entries.title: John 16:28
segments: I came out from the Father, and have come into the world; and now I am to leave the world, and go to the Father."

entries.title: John 16:29
segments: "At last," exclaimed the disciples, "you are using plain words and not speaking in figures at all.

entries.title: John 16:30
segments: Now we are sure that you know everything, and need not wait for any one to question you. This makes us believe that you did come from God."

entries.title: John 16:31
segments: "Do you believe that already?" Jesus answered.

entries.title: John 16:32
segments: "Listen! a time is coming--indeed it has already come--when you are to be scattered, each going his own way, and to leave me alone; and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

entries.title: John 16:33
segments: I have spoken to you in this way, so that in me you may find peace. In the world you will find trouble; yet, take courage! I have conquered the world."
